statement: termio.c (DISPLAY/ACCEPT terminal I/O + the -fdump debug feature) ported function-for-function into gnucobol-rs. All 18/18 functions have a named, ACTIVE Rust counterpart, confirmed by the typed gnucobol-rs-port-index (18/18 active, 0 doc-only, 0 missing) and the authoritative doxygen parse. The DISPLAY-bytes core is oracle-verified byte-for-byte; the dump feature is faithfully ported (pure formatters unit-tested).

coverage.inventory_confirmed_by: gnucobol-rs-port-index (typed: termio.c 18/18 active, 0 doc-only, 0 missing) + doxygen preprocessed C parse (DOXYGEN-PARITY.md termio.c 18/18)

differential_verification.note: DISPLAY-bytes core byte-verified against a cobc program oracle. FAIL=0.
differential_verification.scenario_coverage: pretty signed/unsigned/scaled numeric DISPLAY (default pretty-display: yes), COMP-3 packed, COMP binary, COMP-1/COMP-2 float (%G f-form and e-form), alphanumeric. One source of truth (termio_display_rows) emits the cobc program AND builds the same storage in Rust via the sealed cob_move/float encoders. The cob_display_common family is internal/hidden in libcob.so, so a program oracle is the witness.
differential_verification.self_contained: 5 in-crate unit tests cover the %G/clean_double edges, the pretty path, the cob_display wrapper, and the dump formatters.

non_claims: The -fdump debug feature (dump_field_internal et al.) is ported faithfully as real functions with the pure formatters unit-tested; its full byte output (the OCCURS-collapse 'same as (n)' state machine over the generated whole-record field-tree traversal) is not differentially swept here (it needs the runtime cob_module field-tree model).
cob_display device routing (printer/punch files, screen redirect, popen pipes) is surrounding I/O; this port produces the SYSOUT/SYSERR emitted bytes.
long double (x87 80-bit) display is host-specific; the %.32LG path uses the f64 approximation and is not swept.
cob_accept models the line-read + MOVE; terminal/screen input, crt_status, and SIGINT on ^C are runtime I/O.

license_boundary.statement: Faithful DERIVATIVE PORT of LGPL GnuCOBOL 3.2 termio.c, NOT clean-room. LGPL-3.0-or-later; the Apache-2.0 KOBOLD layer never mixes (gpl-license-guard-receipt.json).
